response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(gc.invoiced_order_count) AS avg_invoiced_order_count, AVG(gc.invoiced_order_count - oa.avg_count) AS avg_excess_overall_average FROM gender_counts AS gc CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE gc.invoiced_order_count > oa.avg_count;
